fields.Name: C1 -> C3.1
fields.Description: Gate G4.9 (owner PR 5, phase 4, dataset C1, criterion C3.1): a session with a low token budget halts at the budget with at most one call of overrun, and every training run logs a compute cost above 0 beside its proper score. On the truth suite's W1-signal world: (1) one planning session with the orchestrator's MaxTokensPerRun lowered in-process to 15,000 -> Failed on the tokens guardrail, the tree's TotalTokensUsed <= the cap + its last prompt call's tokens, RunCost stoppedByBudget; (2) with PS_COMPUTE_USD_PER_SECOND set in-process, an approved build -> every training run stores ComputeCost > 0 beside the trainer's holdout primary score, TokensUsed 0 or unset (no strategist or derivation call), the report row's RunCost parts equal the stored sums, and RunCostReport.Of(build run) equals the stored sums (tokens = root TotalTokensUsed + the runs' TokensUsed; usd = root TotalCost + the runs' ComputeCost). Server transport (the agent runs as the D5-46 person); spends LLM money. Mutation: revert the trainer's TokensUsed to 0, or stop counting failed iterations -> the A6 unit attacks go red. Run budget 30 min (MaxExecutionTimeMS).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The low-budget session halts on its token guardrail within one call of the cap; every training run of the priced build logs ComputeCost > 0 beside its proper score; RunCost equals the stored sums.
